name: Mordor
note: Fan work from Tolkien, whose work belongs to the Tolkien Estate; nothing from any book, film or game is used. This is a country rather than a city: 680 km east to west and 560 km north to south, at true proportion, generated by tools/make-mordor.py. At that scale Barad-dur is a splinter and the Black Gate is a scratch across a valley, which is the point of it. Positions are [lat, lon] against an origin at Mordor's centre, so one degree of latitude is 111,132 m and one of longitude 111,320 m.
attribution: Mordor is fan work: land generated by tools/make-mordor.py. Tolkien's world belongs to the Tolkien Estate. No assets used.

districts._: [name, hex colour, base height, tallest, box as [lat south, lon west, lat north, lon east]]

landmarks.name: Barad-dur
landmarks.info: The Dark Tower, at the end of a spur off the Ered Lithui. Fifteen hundred metres of black iron on a fortress of its own, and it is still a splinter on this map. The Eye at the top of it is another matter: it is lit to be seen from anywhere on the plain, and it sweeps the plain all night.

landmarks.name: Orodruin
landmarks.info: Out on the plateau on its own, four thousand metres above Gorgoroth, and never not erupting. The Sammath Naur is sunk into its head, the fountains stand out of the pool, the flows run down its flanks, and the plume leans away east for thirty kilometres.

landmarks.name: The Black Gate
landmarks.info: Thrown across the gap of Cirith Gorgor where the two ranges almost meet, with the Towers of the Teeth either side of a gate that is shut. Seven kilometres of wall, and on a map of the whole country it is a scratch.

landmarks.name: Minas Morgul
landmarks.info: In its valley on the far side of the Ephel Duath, lit a colour that nothing healthy is lit.

landmarks.name: Cirith Ungol
landmarks.info: The tower on the pass, three tiers on a shoulder of rock, built to watch the way out of Mordor rather than the way in.

landmarks.name: Durthang
landmarks.info: An old Gondorian fort in the northern Ephel Duath, kept by orcs now.

landmarks.name: Udun
landmarks.info: The valley behind the Black Gate, between the two ranges: the mustering ground, and the only level way in.

landmarks.name: The Isenmouthe
landmarks.info: The jaws at the south end of Udun, where the road drops out onto the plateau.

landmarks.name: The Sea of Nurnen
landmarks.info: The only water in Mordor, inland and bitter, with the slave-fields of Nurn worked around its shore.

landmarks.name: The Ered Lithui
landmarks.info: The northern wall, running the whole width of the land and turning south down the east.

landmarks.name: The Ephel Duath
landmarks.info: The western wall, and the southern one: it turns east along the bottom of the land and closes it.

forges._: furnace stacks and their smoke over every works the map marks

hosts._: the hosts on the roads, the Nazgul over the plateau, and lightning in the pall
